project.description:
BioLINCC ETL Pipeline — end-to-end curation run.
Runs: make all (clean → build → deploy → status) Blocks until the pipeline completes or fails on the EC2 Spot instance.
Auto-triggers when biolincc/configs/target_s3_buckets.txt changes on deploy/biolincc (SCM polling). Code-only pushes to deploy/biolincc (e.g. hot patches) do NOT auto-trigger — use Build with Parameters. Also runnable manually via Build with Parameters for sandbox testing.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BRANCH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Git branch to build. Default: deploy/biolincc (auto-triggered). Set to a feature branch for manual sandbox runs.

hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.name: BUCKETS
hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.description:
Override bucket list (one per line). Leave empty to use configs/target_s3_buckets.txt from git.
Example: nih-nhlbi-bdc-biolincc-disc-phs004495-v1-r1-c1

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail [ -f ~/.bashrc ] && source ~/.bashrc || true cd biolincc
# === Build Context === echo "=================================================" echo " Triggered by: $(git log -1 --format='%an <%ae>')" echo " Commit: $(git log -1 --format='%h') — $(git log -1 --format='%s')" echo " Branch: ${BRANCH:-deploy/biolincc}" echo " Build: ${BUILD_URL:-local}" echo "================================================="
if [ -n "${BUCKETS:-}" ]; then echo "$BUCKETS" > configs/target_s3_buckets.txt echo "=== Using override bucket list ===" cat configs/target_s3_buckets.txt else echo "=== Using bucket list from git ===" cat configs/target_s3_buckets.txt fi
if [ "${Destroy:-false}" = "true" ]; then make init && make destroy-force else make all PIPELINE_STATUS=$?
# === SES Email Notification === # SES_SENDER defaults to noreply@hms.harvard.edu; override via Jenkins job env var. SES_SENDER="${SES_SENDER:-thomas_desain@hms.harvard.edu}" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=$(git log -1 --format='%ae') ALL_RECIPIENTS="$GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL" if [ -n "${SES_RECIPIENTS:-}" ]; then ALL_RECIPIENTS="${GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL},${SES_RECIPIENTS}" fi
rm -rf /tmp/etl-reports && mkdir -p /tmp/etl-reports # Assume the 73-account role to read curation reports written by the pipeline unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN _CREDS=$(aws sts assume-role \ --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl \ --role-session-name s3-sync-reports \ --duration-seconds 900 --output json) export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$_CREDS" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId') export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$_CREDS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey') export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$_CREDS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken') unset _CREDS aws s3 sync "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/__pipeline_runs__/mvp_work/curation_reports/current/" \ /tmp/etl-reports/ --no-progress unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
export PIPELINE_STATUS ALL_RECIPIENTS SES_SENDER if python3 scripts/notify.py; then : # notification outcome already logged by notify.py else echo "[notify] WARNING: notification script exited non-zero (Python crash or import error)" echo "[notify] Pipeline result is unaffected." echo "[notify] Re-run manually: cd biolincc && python3 scripts/notify.py" fi
exit $PIPELINE_STATUS fi
